opening.argument: Judge, the offer is a solicitation, not merely a passing mention of an exchange. The description promises a free $30,000 bonus and $20 for signing up, then directs viewers to a registration link. The spoken pitch adds the next steps: register, deposit at least 100, and open a first trade for bigger bonuses. The relevant relationship is the reward attached to a sequence of viewer actions, including putting money into a trading account. The description also offers a separate $20,000 bonus through another registration link. Even if the chart discussion is genuine, it does not erase this repeated effort to move viewers from watching into signing up and trading for advertised rewards.
